title: Murder in the Heartland
description:

Carol Lapaglia waits 25 years to marry the love of her life, Jack Parkes; six weeks before their wedding in Kennedy Township, Pa., she finds him shot to death in their living room.

description:

In Saguache, Colo., mountain bike pioneer Mike Rust disappears from his home, and his remains are not found until seven years later.

title: Murder in the Heartland

In Moscow, Idaho, an elderly couple frantically performs CPR on their young neighbor after a pop of gunfire interrupts their bedtime routine; investigators follow fresh footprints from the scene, only to learn the killer may already be behind bars.

Police struggle to dissect the love triangle that led to the murder of a young woman; her jilted husband and her jealous new boyfriend are prime suspects.

title: On the Case With Paula Zahn
description:
S27 E05 — When the Music's Over
Police discover that the successful wife of a popular DJ has been murdered; the array of video cameras in the neighborhood could help bring her killer to justice.

title: On the Case With Paula Zahn
description:

Police use a revolutionary new technique to sort through a long list of guests and employees at the Paradise Ranch to find the one person responsible for a savage murder.

description:

The disappearance of a 17-year-old girl leads detectives to an investigation spanning two decades; the case soon goes cold, but gets a renewed push after three women escape Ariel Castro's Cleveland house of horrors.

Skeletal remains are found in a military tough box, six feet underground.

Pennsylvania State Troopers are tasked with a haunting murder investigation that takes more than a decade to solve after finding charred and decomposed human remains in the Poconos.

title: How (Not) to Get Rid of a Body
description:

Police find a murder victim inside a Civil War crypt in a historic cemetery in Southwest Philadelphia; detectives from two counties navigate the evils of a notorious motorcycle club to try and solve the case.

title: Evil Lives Here
description:

Lori and Brook have one terrible commonality, Gary Simmons; Gary tortures Lori during their 6-year marriage; later, he imprisons and violates Brook; the two women meet for the first time and share their stories.

title: Evil Lives Here
description:
S17 E08 — He Haunts Me Everyday
When Abbi sees her boyfriend's darkness, she tries to help but cannot; she hopes being a father will change him, but it doesn't; when his cruelty becomes too much to handle, she leaves and discovers who her boyfriend was all along.

title: Evil Lives Here
description:
S17 E09 — Thirty Years of Hell
At 16, Roxie rushes into marriage; her husband manipulates and threatens her nearly every day; she leaves after 30 years but pays a terrible price.

title: Evil Lives Here
description:

Debra believes Randy is a good man and faith will help him overcome his dark past; after they marry, his violent and cruel side takes over; she manages to escape, but the next woman isn't so lucky.

description:
S01 E07 — Dangerous Minds
Jonathan Levin, a popular teacher at a Bronx, N.Y., high school, is found dead in his apartment; police discover he's the son of a wealthy executive, setting off an explosion of rumors in the press and a massive manhunt for Levin's killer.

title: The 1990s: The Deadliest Decade
description:
S01 E03 — Death of an Angel
With their outlandish outfits and crazy antics, the Club Kids rule the nightlife in New York City; the party ends when one of their own goes missing and a body washes up on the shores of Staten Island.

title: The 1990s: The Deadliest Decade
description:
S01 E06 — Roid Rage
A young millionaire couple goes missing from their estate, and their Lamborghini turns up in the Everglades; detectives worry they are the latest victims of a gang of brutal bodybuilders who target Miami entrepreneurs and bleed them dry.

title: Seduced to Slay
description:
S01 E06 — My Brothers Keeper
In the Atlanta suburb of Buford, George and Tia Young raise their three sons; when his childhood friend Tim Lee moves to town, George offers to let him stay with the family; a sinister seduction occurs, leading to a cold-blooded murder.

title: Seduced to Slay
description:
S01 E04 — Thrill Kill
A burned-out car with a body in the trunk and a hidden torture chamber rock the town of Speedway, Indiana; when a similar murder happens in Texas, detectives fear their suspects have crossed state lines and will strike again if they're not stopped.

title: Seduced to Slay
description:
S01 E02 — Star Crossed Killers
When single mother Linda Damm goes missing in Lafayette, Colo., police get an anonymous tip telling them where to find her body and who her unexpected killer is.

title: Seduced to Slay
description:
S01 E03 — Boardwalk Pied Piper
Kosta and Lisa Fotopoulos are a Daytona Beach power couple in 1989; Kosta owns a bar and hires sultry Deidre Hunt as a waitress; soon, a torrid affair, a deadly home invasion and a videotaped murder all result from a tailspin of greed and seduction.

title: Seduced to Slay
description:
S01 E08 — Three-Ring Murder
When Michael's body is found on a local golf course, a dark truth emerges.

title: Seduced to Slay
description:
S01 E01 — Shot in the Dark
Thirty miles outside of Dallas, in Royse City, Texas, Fire Capt. Robert Poynter and his young wife, Chacey, enjoy an idyllic small-town life, but that's shattered when a dramatic physical transformation leads to infidelity and a dead body.

title: Fear Thy Neighbor
description:
S09 E01 — The Secret Wife
A peaceful suburb turns upside down when a family learns that the neighbor has kept a secret wife locked in his home for years; things escalate when the family helps her escape with her baby, leading to a bitter feud that ends in terrible bloodshed.

title: Fear Thy Neighbor
description:
S09 E04 — Commanded to Kill
The paranoid delusions of one young man compel him to conspire against the unwitting family next door; over a series of months, his deteriorating mental condition escalates into a midnight shooting, which shakes the foundation of the neighborhood.

title: Fear Thy Neighbor
description:
S10 E02 — HOA Hellfire
When a resident revives an HOA to beautify her community, some neighbors are unhappy, believing the organization is fraudulent; tensions escalate when liens are placed on the house of a couple unwilling to pay, ending in a suburban shootout.

title: Fear Thy Neighbor
description:
S09 E05 — Full Frontal Attack
A family lends a friend a place to stay but kicks her out after a blow-up; instead of moving away, she buys a house across the street, kicking off a years-long dispute ending in a hail of bullets, blood, death, and a community in shock.

title: Fear Thy Neighbor
description:

title: Fear Thy Neighbor

When Ray and Marie Thornton go out for a drive in the country on Easter Sunday, they are almost chased off the road by a tailgating van and when they see the driver changing license plates and dumping a bloody sheet, they call police.

S01 E03 — Handsome Devil
After a night out in a downtown Denver nightclub, Kenia Monge wanders the streets without a purse or phone; her journey leads to encounters with several men --some good, and one who drives a creepy white van.

When Kathey Horn disappears, some believe she's following the Grateful Dead; others think she was sacrificed during a Wicca initiation; her mom wonders if she's run off with an older boyfriend.

description:

In November 2009, Yei and John Daniels come home to find their house ransacked; a few days later, after enjoying the Christmas of a lifetime, a knock at the door changes their lives forever.

title: Home Alone
description:
S02 E04 — A Mother and a Maniac
Haley McHam decides to leave her abusive partner, Jamie, but he returns the next day to incite terror and leaves her pleading for her life.

title: Home Alone
description:
S02 E03 — Ex-ecutioner
When a single mother breaks up with her volatile boyfriend, she finds out he has other plans for her; armed with a gun, he holds her hostage; as her life hangs in the balance, she has no idea her friend on the SWAT team is determined to save her.

title: Home Alone
description:
S02 E05 — First Flame
Sophia Putney-Wilcox is excited to start her senior year of high school after ending an abusive relationship with her boyfriend, Adam; unable to take the rejection, Adam breaks into her house with a bottle of gasoline and a lighter.

title: Your Worst Nightmare
description:
S05 E04 — Never Let Go
Karen Widdoss thinks she's rid of her possessive ex-boyfriend, Leonard; while dating someone new, Karen can't shake the feeling she's being watched; when a stalker steps out of the shadows, he doesn't look at all like she imagined.

title: Your Worst Nightmare
description:
S05 E03 — Run for Your Life
Despite her family's protests, 19-year-old Micah Rine marries Thomas Pate and moves away with him; when Thomas reports Micah missing after she fails to return home from a run, investigators take a close look at their life together in Tennessee.

title: Your Worst Nightmare
description:
S05 E06 — One Last Goodbye
After breaking free from her controlling ex-husband, single mother Tanya Petro meets and falls helplessly in love with Ron Gibson, only to disappear a few months later.

title: Your Worst Nightmare
description:
S05 E07 — Firestarter
Retired NYPD Detective Chris Hanney stands accused of trying to kill his estranged wife, Audrey Mabrey, by setting her on fire.

title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:
S06 E02 — Hey Look, I'm a Serial Killer
A racially motivated serial killer on death row who targeted civil rights leader Vernon Jordan and pornography publisher Larry Flynt confesses to additional unsolved murders with the help of a shrewd female prosecutor.

title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:
S05 E10 — I'm a Sick Puppy
When a priest from Florida goes missing, police focus on a troubled ex-convict whom he helped support; through multiple interrogations, a psychopathic killer reveals details of a twisted vengeance that escalates to a chilling murder.

title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:
S05 E01 — I Guess My Life Is Over Now
A mother who calls 911 to report her 32-year-old son is threatening her turns up dead in her home; he becomes the only suspect, and when he turns himself in, his pragmatic retelling of the slaying isn't just cold-hearted, it's psychopathic.

title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:
S05 E04 — Heat Will Destroy
After his conviction for the brutal slaying of his wife, a Florida inmate lays claim to another unsolved murder 17 years prior, revealing that he's a manipulative psychopath with a history of violence and an unquenchable thirst for revenge.

title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:
S05 E05 — Hell to Look Forward To
A man confesses to accidentally killing his best friend while cleaning his gun; during his interrogation, he stuns police by revealing that he's behind a long trail of bloodshed and is a serial killer who seems to consider himself an angel of mercy.

title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:
S05 E03 — It Wanted to Kill Somebody
Searchers for a missing woman find her brutally beaten body in a dilapidated house near her home; the case goes cold until a local teen steps forward to reveal that he's the killer.

title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:
S06 E09 — This is What I Chose to Be
Missing persons report leads police to a career criminal and his girlfriend; they uncover a twisted world of illicit schemes, macabre fantasies, and a puppet master manipulating young women down a dark path of sex, drugs and exploitation.

Between 1991 and 2001, several violent sexual assaults occur along I-85 between Wyoming and Utah; the cases remain cold until almost two decades later, when advancements in DNA technology lead detectives straight to a psychopathic sexual predator.

description:

Police charge a son and his wife with the murder of his father until a tip comes from a woman claiming her ex-husband and his friend admitted to the brutal killing; detectives interview the new suspects and uncover a pair of cold-blooded psychopaths.
